transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for meeting with me. As you know, I'm putting together the graduation brunch for a Saturday afternoon out in the backyard, and before I send out the invitations, I want to check in with both of you. I'm planning to keep it relaxed — family bringing some dishes, helping with setup — and I've got the covered patio, tables, and chairs ready to go. What I need your input on is the food plan, the start time, and whether we should include any speeches or amplified music. Nina, Leo, what should I know before I finalize things?
